summary.text: Mike Roberto is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described a 34-year career as a teacher, coach and school administrator, the last five years as superintendent of the Aurora City Schools.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Mike Roberto said he was born and raised in the district, which includes all of Portage County and parts of Summit and Geauga counties, and has lived there for more than 50 years.

He listed education and affordability as his main concerns, citing the state's funding of the Fair School Funding Plan and the expansion of school vouchers, along with housing costs and property taxes.
